description: Solo developer building a 2D web-based resource management game using HTML, CSS, and JS to fulfill the Junior Astronaut challenge.
summary: AstraSim is a 2D web-based simulation game designed to fulfill the "Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge. Players take on the role of an astronaut managing a lunar outpost. The core gameplay loop requires balancing three critical life-support resources: Oxygen, Food, and Solar Power. As time progresses in the simulation, these resources deplete at varying rates based on NASA's Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) concepts. The player must strategically replenish them to survive. This addresses the challenge by gamifying complex resource management, providing an accessible, high-pressure interactive medium for students to understand the harsh realities and sustainability requirements of deep-space habitation.
details:
• What it does: AstraSim simulates outpost resource consumption. Players monitor real-time progress bars and click corresponding UI controls to restore Oxygen, Food, and Power before any system reaches 0% and triggers a mission failure.
  • Benefits & Impact: Educates youth on the fragile nature of space life-support systems through engaging, fast-paced gameplay.
  • Tools Used: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, and Vercel for cloud hosting.
  • Creativity: It transforms raw space survival parameters into an arcade-style UI dashboard that runs seamlessly in any web browser without heavy engine requirements.
